title: DeFi Train by Protekt Protocol
tagline: The easiest way to onboard a friend into DeFi! Hop on the DeFi Train!
description:
👻 Using Aave is the best way to learn about DeFi...

🚂 Buy a $50 ticket to the DeFi Train and email it to a non-DeFi friend!

🤑 Your $50 is deposited into Aave so it starts earning interest immediately!

🤝 For the referral, 20% of the interest accrues to you, so your friend, you, and the DeFi space all win together!
how_its_made:
Smart contracts based on Protekt Protocol, yearn, and USDC deposits via Aave. 



React app via Protekt Protocol.



ReferralToken is an innovative smart contract that allows folks to onboard other individuals into DeFi and claim a portion of the yield that those users get (currently set to 20%). This was inspired by the referrals built into Aave but allows cash backs to scale exponentially over time.
